title: 第17章 战四转蛊师第18章 一个鬼故事
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
近夜。
百事堂的人妥善处理好一切事宜后，都离去了。
残蛊楼恢复了往日宁静。
王昭昭简单做了几个小菜，和老王，李元在竹林小院里煮酒小酌。
“什么？！”
“你要独自揽下处理四转残蛊和五转残蛊的大活？”
“李元，你是不是疯了？”
聊起白天的事，王邻吓得不轻。
“这么大惊小怪干嘛。”
李元十分淡定，“老王，我们认识也快一年了，你还不信我？”
“信倒是信。”
王邻揶揄，“就是不想你那么劳碌，便宜了宗门那些奸贼。”
“怎么是便宜他们呢？”
李元疑问。
“你不知道？”
王邻愤愤道：“现在这种情况，他们必须向第九宫内门申请调人来才能处理，那么做是要扣所有管理者月例的。”
月例，即是九宫蛊巢发放给宗门成员每个月的修行资源。
“哈哈，原来如此。”
李元笑了，难怪蚩显答应的那么痛快。
“你还笑得出来？”

王邻打抱不平。
殊不知这恰好符合李元的心意。
“都是小事，吃亏是福。”
“这个亏我吃了。”
李元一本正经说道。
“唉——”
事已至此，王邻也不好说什么，他已经能预想到，在他离开后，这小子要吃多少亏了。
谁当年还不是个血气方刚，心存热血的少年呢？
遭遇人性的考验后，总会进化成老狐狸的。
夜深。
李元处理好残蛊楼事宜，锁了大门，回到寝房，沉沉睡去。
……
竹林外，一道黑影飘摇而入。
“洞主恐怕伤的不轻，竟然让我冒险来抓血眼蛊。”
那可是珍蛊，早已记录且上报第九宫内门。
若是死了，上面会派人来查的。
“到时候就怪罪在佘无立身上吧，反正死无对证了。”
“隐身虫。”
黑影心中喃喃，唤出一只形似蜥蜴的蛊虫来，旋即整个人融入了空气中，如同凭空消失了一般。
穿过竹林，无形目光锁定残蛊楼旁的寝房。

“闻到了，血眼蛊的气息！”
“听说炼化了血眼蛊的蛊师感知能力极强，不知能否察觉到我的存在？”
黑影心想，最好是能悄无声息掳走炼化了血眼蛊的少女。
若惊醒了其他人，那就只能全杀灭口了。
content_en:
Near night.
After the people from Pepsi Hall properly handled all matters, they all left.
The Can Gu Tower has returned to its former peace.
Wang Zhaozhao made a few simple side dishes, and cooked and drank wine with Lao Wang and Li Yuan in the bamboo forest courtyard.
"What?!"
"You want to take on the big job of dealing with the fourth-level residual Gu and the fifth-level residual Gu on your own?"
"Li Yuan, are you crazy?"
Talking about what happened during the day, Wang Lin was very frightened.
"What's all the fuss about?"
Li Yuan was very calm, "Old Wang, we have known each other for almost a year, and you still don't believe me?"
"I believe it."
Wang Lin teased, "I just don't want you to work so hard and take advantage of the traitors in the sect."
"Why are you cheapening them?"
Li Yuan asked.
"You don't know?"
Wang Lin said angrily: "In this situation, they must apply to the inner gate of the Ninth Palace to transfer someone to handle it. Doing so will deduct the monthly salary of all managers."
The monthly schedule is the monthly cultivation resources distributed by the Nine Palaces Gu Nest to the sect members.
"Haha, that's it."
Li Yuan smiled, no wonder Chi Xian agreed so happily.
"You can still laugh?"
The king's neighbors fought against injustice.
Little did he know that this was exactly what Li Yuan wanted.
"It's all trivial matters. A loss is a blessing."
"It's my fault."
Li Yuan said seriously.
"Alas——"
Now that things have come to this, Wang Lin can't say anything. He can already predict how much loss this kid will suffer after he leaves.
Who was not a young man with a strong heart and a passionate heart?
After encountering the test of human nature, he will always evolve into an old fox.
Late at night.
Li Yuan took care of the affairs of the Can Gu Tower, locked the door, returned to the bedroom, and fell asleep.
…
Outside the bamboo forest, a black shadow drifted in.
"I'm afraid the cave master was seriously injured, but he actually asked me to take the risk to catch the blood eye Gu."
That was a precious Gu, which had already been recorded and reported to the inner gate of the Ninth Palace.
If he is dead, someone will be sent to investigate.
"Then let's blame She Wuli. Anyway, there will be no evidence to prove it."
"Invisible bug."
The black shadow murmured in his heart, summoning a lizard-like Gu insect, and immediately the whole person merged into the air, as if disappearing out of thin air.
Walking through the bamboo forest, invisible eyes locked on the bedroom next to Can Gu Tower.
"I smell the breath of blood eye Gu!"
"I heard that the Gu Master who refined the Blood Eye Gu has extremely strong senses. I wonder if he can detect my presence?"
The black shadow thought to himself that it would be best to kidnap the girl who had refined the blood eye Gu quietly.
If it wakes up other people, they can only kill them all.
